notes.title: Fallnation: Lost Stories launches on Early Access on December 17!
notes.content:
¡Estamos encantados de anunciar que FallNation: Lost Stories se lanzará en Acceso Anticipado la próxima semana, el martes 17!

¡Prepárate para una campaña completa con 3 personajes, 3 biomas, un modo infinito que desbloquear al final, metaprogresión y más!

¡Pero no queremos adelantarnos! El día del lanzamiento publicaremos 2 entradas: una detallando el contenido disponible en Acceso Anticipado y otra con todos los cambios que hemos realizado desde la demo hasta hoy, gracias a vuestros comentarios.

¡Nosotros nos mantendremos ocultos de los horrores del búnker, esperando a que vengáis a salvarnos de este destino cruel el próximo martes! ¡Que tengáis una gran semana!

notes.title: Early Access coming next month!
notes.content:
FallNation: Lost Stories Early Access next month!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839499/93f1a763e8ce92a2eec591186cea502582109ecc.jpg

Explore the horrors of the bunker in this FPS Roguelite

We are happy to announce that we are launching FallNation: Lost Stories into Early Access some time next month (Won't be long, though!). We will communicate a specific date alongside the changes we are made thanks with your feedback on another post early next month.

The game will be only avaiable on Steam and will only have Windows support.

We will be waiting for you in the shadows of the bunker!

notes.title: Demo update 0.1.03 for Fallnation Lost Stories – Gunplay Overhaul, Improved Menu
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

We’re excited to share a major update for Fallnation: Lost Stories, bringing impactful improvements to make your gameplay experience more intense and enjoyable. Thanks to your feedback, we’ve refined several key areas, particularly gunplay, menu functionality, balance, and immersion. Here’s what you can expect in this update:
 Gunplay Overhaul 
Enhanced Shooting Mechanics: We’ve focused on creating a more responsive and satisfying shooting experience. Expect realistic feedback with area-specific damage, making every shot count and adding a new layer of strategy. 
Improved Enemy Physics: Enemies now react more dynamically when they’re hit, with refined physics to make encounters more visceral and realistic. 
UI and Sound Enhancements  
Complete Menu Rework: Navigate our newly designed menus with ease—cleaner visuals, improved navigation, and an overall smoother user experience await you. 
Reduced Noise Pollution: We’ve lowered certain sharp sounds that could potentially trigger tinnitus, enhancing your auditory experience. 
 Gameplay Balancing and Quality of Life  
Better Balance: General adjustments make the game fairer and more challenging, addressing some feedback on difficulty spikes.
 Bug Fixes: Numerous bug fixes have been implemented to ensure smoother gameplay and minimize interruptions. 
Try It and Share Your Feedback!
Dive back into Fallnation: Lost Stories and experience the enhanced action firsthand. Your feedback is essential to us, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts on this update! If you haven’t already done so, add the game to your wishlist to stay up-to-date with our latest improvements and upcoming features. 

Thank you for your continued support, and we’ll see you out there, Survivors!
